name: Deadline Day
summary: Deadline Day is a live sports auction you play with friends on your phones. Everyone gets 100M of play money, players come up one at a time, and the highest bid when the clock runs out wins him. When the squads are full, you pick your lineup and the match is simulated: the stronger team always wins, and every manager gets a verdict on how they bid. Six sports (football, basketball, handball, ice hockey, racing and esports), plus Imposter and Guess the player for the same group. Put it on a TV with deadlineday.app/tv and everyone joins by scanning a QR code. Free for up to 4 players in the browser, no download and no sign-up.
